title: 第9章 报告第10章 都是套路
lines: 第9章报告
宋刚将两人送到门口，站在门外，挥着手，一直看到车子一个加速汇入车流中，才猛抽了口气，低头看了遍手里的两张名片，一个旋身，连走带跑往后面奔。
他家这小侦探社门面是自己的，前店后家。
宋刚一头冲进厨房，冲媳妇苗青不停的挥着手里的两张名片，“案子来了，大案子！还真来了。”
“我瞧瞧。”正洗着菜的苗青眼睛亮了，忙擦了把手，一把接过那两张名片，头一眼先看到邹玲两个字，一声惊叫。
“出什么事了？有案子了？”宋刚大女儿宋词一阵风冲进来。
“不是让你看着小弟写作业？”苗青急忙将两张名片背到身后，“这没你的事儿。”
“怎么没我的事儿？宋问打死也不做侦探，宋笑那么笨，我不管，难道让咱们宋家竖了几百年的招牌倒下去啊？”宋词可一点儿也不怕她妈。
“宋词说的也对。”宋刚一脸干笑，“咱们祖上那些入行的姑奶奶，有一个算一个，全是神探。”
“老爸英明！”宋词冲上去挽住她爸的胳膊，在宋刚脸上响亮的亲了下。
“你就惯着她！”苗青狠横了宋刚一眼，“小姑娘找家大公司，坐坐办公室，多轻松多体面，算了算了，算我白操心。”
苗青有点儿生气了，将两张名片拍在宋刚手里，宋词一把抢过，“我的人生我作主，我就是觉得当神探好。喔噢！邹玲！邹大律师！是邹大律师！”
宋词扫了眼头一张名片，一声惊叫，简直要跳起来了。
“邹大律师！爸你不知道邹大律师？你连邹大律师都不知道？”宋词瞪着一脸茫然的她爸，唉唉唉跺着脚，“我就说吧，我不管不行！还有这个，天哪，陈清！爸，你不会连陈清都不知道吧？要查什么？陈清中风了，听说话都说不清楚了，真是，还不到四十呢。陈清可帅了！”
宋词兴奋的两眼放光。
“这个，你跟，那个，说了没有？”苗青往宋词手里指了指，又往门外努了努嘴。
“我想着先跟你说一声，现在就去。”宋刚伸手从女儿手里拿过名片，刚要抬脚，又看着苗青道：“她那间旧货店，开门晚，关门早，这会儿，早该关门了。”
“说不定正等着咱们呢，这么大案子，肯定不是自己找来的，爸，我陪你去。”宋词一把挽住宋刚。
“去得去一趟，关门了你就赶紧回来，一会儿就能吃饭了。”苗青冲宋刚和宋词挥了挥手。
宋词拖着她爸，出了门，直奔隔了一条街的那家旧货店。
旧货店果然已经关门了。
中午周凯走后，盛夏挪到廊下，摇着摇椅，喝着茶，懒懒散散的和米丽说着过往闲话，下午压根就没去开门。
第二天上午，米丽刚到店门口，门还没开开，宋刚就冲上来，笑的眼睛只有一条线了，“昨天晚上我就来过一趟，有案子了，看来是个大案子。”
“是邹玲邹大律师带来的，要查陈清……”宋刚话音还没落，宋词就急急补充道。
“进来再说吧。”米丽白了眼明显兴奋的有点过头的宋词，打断了她的话。
宋词下意识的抬手捂在嘴上，她太着急了，这还在大街上呢！
米丽开了店门，让着两人坐下，抬手止住欠了欠屁股，急着要说话的宋词，进里间接了水，淘了块抹布，将茶桌擦了一遍，换了块抹布，将椅子桌腿也擦了一遍，洗了手，烧上水，开始摆茶席。
content_en:
Chapter 9 Report
Song Gang sent the two of them to the door, stood outside the door, waving, until he saw the car speeding up and merging into the traffic, then he took a sharp breath, looked down at the two business cards in his hand, turned around, and ran towards the back.
The front of his small detective agency is his own, with a shop in front and a home in the back.
Song Gang rushed into the kitchen and waved the two business cards in his hand to his wife Miao Qing, "The case is here, a big case! It's really here."
"Let me take a look." Miao Qing's eyes lit up while she was washing the vegetables. She quickly wiped the handle and took the two business cards. She saw the word "Zou Ling" at the first glance and screamed in surprise.
"What happened? Is there a case?" Song Gang's eldest daughter, Song Ci, rushed in with a gust of wind.
"Didn't I ask you to watch my little brother do his homework?" Miao Qing hurriedly put the two business cards behind his back, "This is none of your business."
"Why is it none of my business? Song Wen won't do detective work even if he kills her. Song Xiao is so stupid. I don't care. Are we going to let the signboard that our Song family has put up for hundreds of years fall down?" Song Ci was not afraid of her mother at all.
"Song Ci is right." Song Gang smiled dryly, "All the aunts from our ancestors who entered the industry were great detectives."
"Dad is wise!" Song Ci rushed up to hold her father's arm and kissed Song Gang loudly on the face.
"Just spoil her!" Miao Qing gave Song Gang a hard look, "This little girl can find a big company and sit in an office. It will be so relaxing and respectable. Forget it, it's no use for me to worry about it."
Miao Qing was a little angry and slapped the two business cards in Song Gang's hand. Song Ci snatched them away, "I have the final say in my life. I just think it's good to be a detective. Oh! Zou Ling! Attorney Zou! It's Attorney Zou!"
Song Ci glanced at the first business card and screamed, almost jumping to his feet.
"Lawyer Zou! Dad, you don't know about Counselor Zou? You don't even know about Counselor Zou?" Song Ci glared at her father, who was confused, and stamped her feet, "I'll just say it, I don't care! And this, my God, Chen Qing! Dad, you don't even know Chen Qing, right? What are you looking for? Chen Qing had a stroke, and he couldn't speak clearly. Really, he's not even forty yet. Chen Qing is so handsome!"
Song Ci's eyes shone with excitement.
"Have you told me about this?" Miao Qing pointed at Song Ci's hand, then pursed his lips toward the door.
"I thought I'd tell you first and go now." Song Gang reached out and took the business card from his daughter's hand. Just as he was about to lift his feet, he looked at Miao Qing and said, "Her thrift store opens late and closes early. By now, it should have closed long ago."
"Maybe they are waiting for us. Such a big case must not have been brought about by yourself. Dad, I will go with you." Song Ci hugged Song Gang.
"You have to go. Come back as soon as it closes. You can have dinner in a while." Miao Qing waved to Song Gang and Song Ci.
Song Ci dragged her father out of the door and went straight to the thrift store across the street.
Sure enough, the thrift store was closed.
After Zhou Kai left at noon, Shengxia moved to the corridor, rocked the rocking chair, drank tea, and lazily chatted with Millie about the past. She didn't open the door at all in the afternoon.
The next morning, as soon as Mi Li arrived at the door of the store, Song Gang rushed up to her before the door opened, her eyes only smiling as she said, "I came here last night. There is a case. It seems to be a big case."
"It was brought by lawyer Zou Ling and Zou to investigate Chen Qing..." Before Song Gang could finish his words, Song Ci added hastily.
"Let's talk after we come in." Mi Li rolled her eyes at Song Ci, who was obviously overly excited, and interrupted her.
Song Ci subconsciously raised her hand to cover her mouth. She was too anxious. She was still on the street!
Mili opened the door of the shop and let the two of them sit down. She raised her hand to stop yawning and Song Ci, who was in a hurry to speak, went inside to get some water, found a rag, wiped the tea table, replaced it with a rag, wiped the chair and table legs again, washed her hands, boiled water, and started to set up the tea banquet.
title_en: Chapter 9 Report Chapter 10 It’s all a routine
